summary: No repository dataset found with repeated regenerated-tail-length measurements over time in tadpoles; BioImage Archive and Dryad searches returned nothing relevant, and the only tadpole tail-regeneration data record located (figshare 30019333, CC BY) records a single categorical outcome at one week for 503 Xenopus laevis tadpoles, which cannot yield a velocity-versus-time curve.
next_step: Compile daily regenerate-length series from paper figures/supplements (Xenopus laevis tail regeneration studies report length at 1,3,5,7 dpa in figures) or generate a dense time-lapse series; Thompson's own tabulated tadpole series (Ch. III) can be digitised from the book as a first dataset.
obstacles_confirmed: Length-versus-time series are in individual papers, not a shared archive.
Few public series have dense enough time sampling to estimate velocity.
